verdict.rationale: Linear supports natural-language interaction extensively: users can @mention or delegate issues to Linear Agent in plain language, describe Loops jobs 'in plain language,' write updates via 'Write with Agent,' and the official MCP server allows AI agents/assistants to operate Linear via natural-language prompts. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming reliability of natural-language command interpretation, and no evidence of a conversational command palette for non-coding actions beyond agent delegation.
